title: Zoo Explorer Trail
hook: Look from here, let wildlife be!
Name the picture, A to Z!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool zoo-explorer storybook, map-and-binocular mood, friendly habitats, clean isolated animal subjects

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 gives one visible habitat or body clue per animal and frames wildlife as something to observe respectfully, never chase or touch.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses track-and-name recall followed by species-conditioned observation gestures: horns curve, trunks lift, primate hands grasp, cats show spots/stripes or tails, canids show muzzle/ears, marsupials hop or balance, marine mammals show flippers, birds use bill/leg/ground-or-flight clues, and reptiles/amphibians use scale/tail/hop clues. No chase, feeding, touching, riding, or approach prompts.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a binocular-click woodblock followed by a warm marimba confirmation.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a binocular-click woodblock followed by a warm marimba confirmation
